entities.summary: Marlon Tañan Tapales is a Filipino professional boxer. He has held world championships in two weight classes, including the World Boxing Organization (WBO) bantamweight title from 2016 to 2017 and the unified World Boxing Association (WBA) and International Boxing Federation (IBF) super-bantamweight titles in 2023.
